svg.title: Experience: Cognizant, Software Engineer · First Citizens Bank platform, Apr 2026 – present; FIS Global, Software Engineer → Senior Software Engineer, Jul 2021 – Apr 2026; Aniworks, Software Development Intern, Jul 2020 – Aug 2020
svg.text: Software Engineer · First Citizens Bank platform
Same platform, team, and client, carried over from FIS Global. Backend API architecture on
Java 21, Spring Boot 3.5, and Kafka in a 25+ engineer delivery team, and mentoring junior
Spring Boot microservices across a 30+ service estate for retail, mobile, and corporate
banking: maker-checker authorisation for PCI-DSS and SOX, card-on-file tokenisation for
Visa and Mastercard, RFC 6238 TOTP with push approval, Video KYC, LLM banking
assistants, and the ELK and Kafka observability rollout.
Above & Beyond Individual Award · FIS Global · Q1 2024, for critical project delivery
B.E. COMPUTER SCIENCE AND ENGINEERING · SRI SIDDHARTHA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY · 2017 – 2021
